backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend that handles user profiles, event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar), and admin-only stats/queries using access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single implemented feature: replacing black background color values in frontend/src/index.css with royal beige #DCCBB5.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (home, technical, non-technical, register, payment, success, contact, admin, dashboard), wraps the app in QueryClient and RegistrationProvider, and shows a PhoenixIntro splash on first visit.
frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.t: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: SVG-based decorative background component that renders a repeating orange circuit board pattern with lines, IC chip shapes, and dots at a configurable opacity.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Live countdown timer component that counts down to March 10, 2026, updating every second and displaying days, hours, minutes, and seconds with neon orange glow styling and a glassmorphism container.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with a brand section, quick navigation links, and contact/coordinator info styled with a black/gold/orange theme using inline styles.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Displays an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, progress bar, and cycling status messages that completes after ~3 seconds and calls onComplete.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with desktop links and a mobile hamburger menu, highlighting the active route and applying scroll-based background opacity changes.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen intro animation featuring a phoenix image with ember particle canvas effects and a radial glow, fading out and calling onComplete after ~7 seconds.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: Provides a React context for storing, updating, and clearing event registration form data (participant info, event type, amount) across the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout state, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting registrations, fetching all registrations, fetching stats, and deleting a registration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for a neon-cyan dark theme, and utility classes for neon text/border/glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin control panel page with a hardcoded credential login form and a dashboard for viewing and managing event registrations, protected behind a local username/password check.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details with a dark glassmorphism UI featuring orange neon glow effects and a circuit background pattern.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that lists all registrations with delete functionality, a confirmation dialog, and an Excel export option, using React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for the VibECX-2K26 event featuring a hero section with animated title, event stats, and navigation to other pages, styled with a dark metallic/neon aesthetic.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Displays a grid of non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) for VibECX-2K26 with icons, descriptions, and orange-themed styling on a black background.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Handles the payment step of registration by displaying a QR code amount loaded from localStorage, accepting a payment screenshot upload, and submitting the full registration to the backend before navigating to the success page.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Renders the event registration form, calculates fees based on member count and event type, saves data to the backend actor and localStorage, then navigates to the Payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Shows a filterable day schedule of VibECX events (technical, non-technical, general) with time, duration, venue, and description, styled with color-coded type badges.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Displays a registration success confirmation page with a checkmark icon, a message about email confirmation, and a button to return home after a successful VibECX-2K26 registration submission.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Renders the Technical Events page for VibECX-2K26, displaying five events (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) in a styled grid with orange gradient theming and hover effects.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Provides utility functions to export registration data as a CSV file, including helpers to format IC nanosecond timestamps and event type variants into human-readable strings.
frontend/src/utils/excelExport.ts: Exports registration records to an Excel (.xlsx) file using SheetJS loaded dynamically from CDN, with formatted timestamps, event types, and predefined column widths.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Rajdhani), neon cyan color palette, OKLCH-based semantic colors, neon box-shadow utilities, and animation keyframes for accordion and neon-pulse effects.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state and architecture for VibECX-2K26, noting that the global body background is being changed from black to royal beige (#DCCBB5) across all pages.
